correctness.rationale: For a column (a,b), the two NEC majorities return (a,b) when a=b, otherwise copy both bits from the next eastern column; this is an exact two-case identity, not a heuristic. First original equal-bit seed to the east fixes each site, and a seedless word translates without a fixed row-equal destination. Cyclic y-interfaces force original seed columns and every remaining column has exactly three possible states, yielding 3^(n-k), with the all-unequal exception 2^n for homogeneous y. The 2×2 transfer matrix T=[[3,1],[1,3]] has eigenvalues 4,2; trace(T^n)−2^(n+1)=4^n−2^n. Sign insertions give all r-spin correlation numerators 4^(n−r)2^r+4^r2^(n−r)−2^(n+1). Perron eigenvalue dominance gives limiting transition T/4 and zero-field coupling J=(log3)/2, with correlation 2^-r and length 1/log2. Independently enumerated all 4^n states, output basins and entry times for n=3,4,5,6 by the original synchronous site-majority; this finite check complements the all-n seed proof.
